blackbox_legality: deployment-legal signal type; benchmarks themselves eval-only-gold (human-labeled)
availability: S2S-Arena published ACL 2026; MTalk-Bench project page freedomintelligence.github.io/MTalk-Bench/
known_reliability_numbers: MTalk-Bench: Arena and Rubrics yield consistent/complementary rankings but reliable distinctions only when performance gaps are large; LLM-as-judge aligns with humans when gaps are clear or criteria explicit; exhibits position and length bias; reliable on nonverbal (paralinguistic) evaluation ONLY with text annotations provided
p_slot_fit: P9/P10 (dual-protocol design and the 'only reliable with text annotation' finding directly constrain any paralinguistic-evaluation design)
source_pointer: survey-fulltext store 2026.acl-long.1615.txt lines 1-55 (not in the scratchpad pin set); survey-fulltext store 2508.18240.txt lines 1-55 (not in the scratchpad pin set)

name: Gemini family as full-duplex conversation-quality judge (2.5 Flash / 3.5 Flash / 3.1 Pro)
type: LALM judge scoring raw stereo waveform directly, 8 production dimensions, validated against 3-rater human reference
blackbox_legality: deployment-legal (industry production validation study); reference set (209 sessions) is eval-only-gold and NOT publicly available
availability: internal Salesforce dataset/pipeline, not released
known_reliability_numbers: 5/8 dims: LALM-human Spearman rho departs from human-human rho by <=0.07; 7/8 dims: 95% CIs overlap; agrees with 3-rater human mean within 1pt on 60-92% of sessions (6/8 dims); 45/48 (defect,dimension) cells LALM as sensitive as humans or better (mostly underpowered nulls); 3.5 Flash improves simple agreement to 8/8 dims; 3.1 Pro rates several dims markedly lower despite comparable rank correlation -- model swap must re-validate calibration, not assume from rank-correlation alone; human rating costs ~2 orders of magnitude more than equivalent LALM workload
p_slot_fit: P9/P10 (strongest available production-grade LALM-judge validation methodology; per-dimension substitutability framing directly reusable)
